Meta and TikTok both now let outside AI tools work inside your ad accounts, and TikTok describes agents shifting budget without a person stepping in at each stage.

Our view is to connect agents for reporting now, and allow budget or targeting changes only once a named person has written down what an agent may change and who approves it. TikTok's authorisation lapses after 30 days, which gives you a natural monthly review.

Both platforms are also testing checkout inside their apps, which runs on your product data. Give your AI your feed export and it flags the gaps product by product and drafts the missing copy for someone to check.

The full episode and article are at https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/meta-tiktok-advertising-week-ai-ad-tools/ (the podcast voices are AI-generated).

clips.linkedin:
Give your AI your product feed and it flags every product missing sizing, materials, returns terms or stock.

Meta and TikTok are both testing checkout inside their apps. There's no UK date yet, but the work it needs is in your product data, and that can start now.

TikTok's Shopping Assistant answers from merchant information, and Meta's checkout pulls products from Shopify Catalog. Complete titles, sizing, returns terms and stock data give an assistant better material. Shopify also says Google Analytics won't fire in Meta's direct checkout, so a team reporting from it wouldn't see those sales.

Give your AI a feed export. It goes product by product, flags where sizing, materials, returns terms or stock aren't in plain text, and drafts the missing copy for someone to check.

clips.text: The other practical point is checkout prep. Shopping Assistant answers from merchant information, and Meta's checkout pulls products from Shopify Catalog. So complete titles, sizing, returns terms and stock data give an assistant better material. And Shopify says Google Analytics and custom pixels won't fire in Meta's direct checkout, only server-to-server events. So a team reporting from Google Analytics wouldn't see those sales at all. Right. Get AI on this. First, your product feed.
